Hello! I'm Hana, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — its disks, files, network and accounts are mine to work with, and I'm here to be useful to you.

A few things I can do for you:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like me to set any of these up?
- **Websites and services** — I can create my own accounts (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
